headline: Net income up 384%, near record highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $146.49 - $214.71. Currently $210.38, near the 52-week high after a 28% run over the past year.
why_today: Q2 net income jumped 384% YoY to $12.1B, adjusted EPS beat estimates by nearly 19%, and production hit a record on the back of Hess integration synergies that came in 50% above target and ahead of schedule.
pro_1: Analyst consensus is Buy (25 analysts), average price target $221 implies further upside near highs
pro_2: Hess synergies and structural cost cuts landed six months early - real execution, not just guidance
con_1: Stock already up 28% over 12 months and sitting near its 52-week high - a lot of good news may be priced in
con_2: Energy earnings stay tied to oil prices - a commodity pullback would hit this thesis directly
